note: Nallino, Part II p. 237: at the second hour of Cancer after culmination read 22′ for 21′ in the longitude. The second hour before culmination has 22′ 8′, and every value of a clime is printed twice

Nallino, Part II p. 237: 16° 39′ (لط) for the codex's 16° 32′ (لب), precisely 16° 38′ 48″. The longest day of the title, 13ʰ, holds at 16° 38.8′ with the obliquity 23° 35′, and the half-days of the table agree with it

Nallino, Part II p. 237: 24° 5′ (ه) for the codex's 24° (with the zero sign for the minutes, which the print omits), precisely 24° 4′ 47″. The longest day of the title, 13ʰ 30ᵐ, holds at 24° 4.8′ with the obliquity 23° 35′, and the half-days of the table agree with it

Nallino, Part II p. 237: 48° 53′ (نج) for the codex's 48° 13′ (يج), precisely 48° 52′ 46″. The longest day of the title, 16ʰ, holds at 48° 52.6′ with the obliquity 23° 35′, and the half-days of the table agree with it
